text: otene is an agonist at the retinoid X receptor, which is involved in the regulation of cell differentia- tion and proliferation. It is used in the treatment of cu- taneous T-cell lymphoma (see Mycosis Fungoides, p.657), in a usual initial oral dose of 300 mg/m2 daily as a single dose taken with a meal. Dosage is adjusted according to toxicity. For the topical treatment of re- fractory disease a 1% gel may be applied on alternate days for the first week, gradually increased at weekly intervals to up to 4 times daily, depending on tolerance. ◊ References. 1.
